attchmntText: West Coast Paper Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: West Coast Paper Mills Limited has published a newspaper advertisement regarding its financial results as on 30th September 2026. The advertisement appeared in Business Standard in English and Karavali Munjavu in Kannada. The company has submitted a copy of this advertisement to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. for their records. The script codes are BSE 500444 and NSE WSTCSTPAPR. The intimation was signed by Brajmohan Prasad, Company Secretary, with membership number F7492.

attchmntText: West Coast Paper Mills Limited has informed the Exchange pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 on related party transactions, consolidated basis for the half year ended on September 30 2026.

West Coast Paper Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended on 30th September 2026 and additional capacity expansion of Optical Fiber and Optical Fiber Cable of West Coast Optilinks, a division of West Coast Paper Mills Limited.".
West Coast Paper Mills Limited has informed the Exchange about Financials Results for Quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 and Outcome of the Board Meeting.
West Coast Paper Mills Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
